newsitem.title: USA: Guccione's co seeks to stop DOD adult magazine ban.
newsitem.headline: Guccione's co seeks to stop DOD adult magazine ban.

text.p: Spokepeople for Penthouse publisher Bob Guccione said on Tuesday that Guccione's company, General Media International, will file a complaint against U.S. Defense Secretary William Perry and the Defense Department to overturn an act barring the sale of periodicals and videos depicting nudity and sex in a "lascivious way."

The complaint, to be filed later this week in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, will demand a preliminary and a permanent injunction against the Military Honor and Decency Act, Guccione's spokepeople said.

The Act was part of the general defense authorization bill signed by President Clinton on September 23. A provision in the bill barring the sale of sexually explicit material on property under Defense Department jurisdiction becomes effective December 22, Guccione's spokespeople said.
In a statememt, Guccione called the provision "absolutely outrageous and totally unconstitutional" and said U.S. officials "are not going to get away with it."
